xtmux-rs3.description:
PROBLEM: 'sp run executor --bead <id> --background' invoked from a fresh core worktree (in an xt-claude Claude Code pane, from within cwd /home/dawid/dev/core/.xtrm/worktrees/xtmux-1lb.5/) prints 'Warning: job started but ID not yet available.' but no job appears in sp ps / sp ps --all / .specialists/jobs/. Foreground bd checks confirm the bead exists and resolves via bd -C ~/dev/xtmux. Discovered while driving xtmux-1lb.5 (2026-07-11). Worked around by implementing inline; feels like an sp/pi environment issue rather than xtmux/core code.

Repro: fresh core worktree, cd into it, sp run executor --bead xtmux-1lb.5 --background. Expected: job ID printed on stderr, job visible in sp ps. Actual: silent no-op with generic warning.

SCOPE: unclear until bisected; sp process/subprocess spawn path OR cwd-reset from the CLAUDE hook environment competing with sp's fork.

DISCOVERED_FROM: xtmux-1lb driver session (2026-07-11, jaggerxtrm).
xtmux-rs3.title: sp run --background from a fresh core worktree cwd silently fails (no job registered, no error)
